parent.name: Coats & Jackets
parent.headline:
The outside layer.
The inside feeling.
parent.description:
The everyday jacket. The considered coat.
A finishing layer for wherever life takes you.
parent.style: Make an entrance. Feel like yourself.
parent.advice: Throw a trench over familiar denim. Add a tailored layer to a simple knit. Choose a textured jacket when the rest is quiet. The piece you put on last can give the whole outfit a new point of view.
parent.detailLine: A seam. A collar. A different feeling.
parent.heroAlt: Campaign inspiration: a woman wearing a camel coat over an ivory knit on a quiet stone street
parent.campaignNote: The parent campaign image is illustrative styling inspiration. Subcategory images and product cards use existing WOW Fashion product photography.

collections.name: Bomber Jackets
collections.headline:
A little attitude.
An easy finish.
collections.description: Relaxed shapes, expressive prints and a zip-and-go feeling. Find a bomber jacket that makes the everyday your own.
collections.advice: Pair a shorter bomber with high-waisted trousers or straight-leg jeans. Let a patterned jacket lead, and keep the layers underneath simple.

collections.name: Casual Coats
collections.headline:
Out the door.
Into your day.
collections.description: Easy outer layers for coffee runs, changing plans and everything in between. Find the coat that fits your everyday rhythm.
collections.advice: Choose a shape that works over your usual layers. A defined waist gives a relaxed coat structure, while an open front keeps the outfit underneath in view.

collections.name: Faux Fur Coats
collections.headline:
A softer side.
A bolder mood.
collections.description: Plush-looking textures and expressive silhouettes. Explore faux-fur styles that bring a different feeling to familiar outfits.
collections.advice: Try a textured coat over simple denim or smooth tailoring. Keep accessories understated and check the individual listing for its exact material and care details.

collections.name: Fleece Jackets
collections.headline:
Soft textures.
Slow-day energy.
collections.description: From relaxed zip fronts to teddy-inspired shapes. Discover fleece-category layers with an off-duty point of view.
collections.advice: A fuller jacket pairs well with a straighter trouser. Leave enough room at the shoulder for a base layer, and check the listing for fabric composition and lining.

collections.name: Jean and Denim Jackets
collections.headline:
Familiar denim.
A fresh direction.
collections.description: A cropped shape, a different wash, an unexpected detail. Discover denim jackets with plenty of ways to wear them.
collections.advice: Wear a denim jacket over a soft dress or with tailored trousers. For double denim, try contrasting washes and keep the rest of the outfit simple.

collections.name: Leather Jackets
collections.headline:
An edge.
Your own way.
collections.description: Biker shapes, clean zips and considered details. Explore the leather-look edit, from classic black to softer colours.
collections.advice: Balance a structured jacket with a fluid skirt or a simple knit. This shop category includes leather-look and faux-leather styles; check each listing for the exact material.

collections.name: Light Jackets
collections.headline:
Just one layer.
So many plans.
collections.description: Easy shapes for the moments between seasons. Find a lighter-looking jacket to keep close when the day changes.
collections.advice: Choose a jacket that sits comfortably over your everyday top. Check fabric weight, lining and product details rather than relying on the category name alone.

collections.name: Linen Jackets
collections.headline:
An easy line.
A lighter outlook.
collections.description: Relaxed silhouettes and understated details from the linen jacket edit. An unhurried approach to getting dressed.
collections.advice: Pair a loose jacket with a simple tee and straight trousers, or drape it over a dress. Check the listing for its fibre blend and follow the garment’s care label.

collections.name: Long Parka Coats
collections.headline:
Go a little
further.
collections.description: Longer layers, useful-looking details and room to move. Find a parka shape that works with the day ahead.
collections.advice: Check the coat’s length against the layers you usually wear. Try a longer parka with a clean trouser shape and leave enough room through the shoulders for a knit.

collections.name: Military and Cargo Jackets
collections.headline:
A useful detail.
A strong point of view.
collections.description: Cargo-inspired pockets, utility shapes and expressive patterns. Explore an everyday layer with a little more character.
collections.advice: Try a cargo-style jacket over a plain tee or a soft dress. Keep the rest of the outfit uncomplicated so the pockets, seams and pattern have room to stand out.

collections.name: Quilted Jackets
collections.headline:
Stitch by stitch.
Make it yours.
collections.description: Considered quilting, padded shapes and easy silhouettes. Discover a textured finish for your everyday wardrobe.
collections.advice: Pair a padded jacket with straight or tapered trousers. For a defined shape, try a belted style. Check the product details for fill, lining and care instructions.

collections.name: Rain Jackets
collections.headline:
Clouds ahead.
Plans still on.
collections.description: Hoods, longer shapes and practical-looking layers from the rain jacket edit. Find a style to keep in mind when the forecast changes.
collections.advice: Check the individual listing for waterproofing, seams and fastening details before choosing for wet weather. Leave space for the outfit you plan to wear underneath.

collections.name: Trench Coats
collections.headline:
A familiar classic.
Your next chapter.
collections.description: Long lines, a defined waist and a considered finish. Explore trench-style coats for wherever the day leads.
collections.advice: Leave the coat open to show the outfit beneath, or loosely knot the belt for definition. Try it over denim for an easy day or tailoring for a more polished start.

collections.name: Winter Coats
collections.headline:
Step outside.
Stay yourself.
collections.description: Longer silhouettes, fuller textures and room for a favourite knit. Discover the winter coat edit.
collections.style: Build the outfit from the inside
collections.advice: Try your coat over the layers you expect to wear. Warmth depends on fabric, lining, fill and fit; check the individual listing to choose for your conditions.

collections.name: Work and Pea Coats
collections.headline:
A considered start.
A confident finish.
collections.description: Tailored-looking lines, interesting checks and a more composed silhouette. Find a finishing layer for the working week and beyond.
collections.advice: Pair a structured coat or jacket with a simple blouse and straight trousers. Check shoulder fit and sleeve length so the layers underneath sit comfortably.

collections.name: Down Coats
collections.headline:
Light in spirit.
Layered for the day.
collections.description: Padded shapes and longer options from the down coat edit. Discover a silhouette that works with your winter wardrobe.
collections.advice: The fill and lining matter as much as the shape. Read the product’s composition and care details, and leave enough room for your chosen base layers.

collections.name: Fall Jackets
collections.headline:
Changing leaves.
A different layer.
collections.description: Checks, textured finishes and everyday shapes for the autumn wardrobe. Find a jacket to make familiar outfits feel new.
collections.advice: Try a jacket over a light knit and add a scarf when needed. Choose a shape that can accommodate another layer without feeling tight through the shoulder.

collections.name: Spring Jackets
collections.headline:
A fresh day.
A lighter mood.
collections.description: Fresh colours, easy cuts and layers for changing plans. Explore the spring jacket edit and find a new starting point.
collections.advice: A shorter jacket works with a high waist or a flowing dress. Choose layers you can add or remove, and check the product details for weight and fabric.
